designs.name: Road race

designs.description: A lightweight criterium / road-race geometry: steep angles, short stays, aggressive stack and reach.

designs.name: Gravel
designs.author: Bike Box
designs.description: An all-road gravel bike with generous tire clearance, a slacker head angle and a taller stack.

designs.name: Touring
designs.author: Bike Box
designs.description: A loaded-touring frame: long wheelbase, low BB, rack and fender mounts, relaxed fit.

designs.name: 650b Randonneur
designs.author: Bike Box
designs.description: A classic low-trail 650b randonneur for wide tires, a front load and all-day comfort.

designs.name: Track
designs.author: Bike Box
designs.description: A fixed-gear track frame: steep, stiff, high BB for pedal clearance, track ends.

designs.name: XC hardtail (29er)
designs.author: Bike Box
designs.description: A cross-country hardtail for 29" wheels with a suspension-corrected front end.
